children: The Swiss franc's exchange rate is a challenge for the Swiss economy, but in real terms, the currency has been broadly stable since 2020, Swiss National Bank Chairman Martin Schlegel said on Friday.
Schlegel was speaking at an event hosted by Swiss business association economiesuisse in the central city of Lucerne.
